'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Emil Wallin LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Day 3 Light is the same as the Day 2 There Is Good In Him list, with the substitutions written on the Day 3 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' Darth-Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
